title: Work Item Label Taxonomy
description: Display-only label taxonomy for WorkItem.labels. Typed WorkItemContext (canonical chain tenant_slug -> organization_id -> project_id -> mission_id -> task_id plus work_shape, see libs/core/entity-scope.ts ENTITY_SCOPE_HIERARCHY) is the source of truth for search, restoration, and authorization; labels must never be used as authorization input or as the primary lookup key. Governed work-item writes validate this taxonomy through a schema reference.

missionLabel.title: Mission display label
missionLabel.description: Display-only marker duplicating context.mission_id. Search and restoration resolve context.mission_id first.

teamRoleLabel.title: Team role display label
teamRoleLabel.description: Display-only marker for the assigned team role. Open vocabulary; lowercase with underscores by convention.

governanceLabel.title: Governance display label
governanceLabel.description: Display-only marker. The authoritative governance signal is context.work_shape == governance_cadence.

ungovernedDisplayLabel.title: Ungoverned display label
ungovernedDisplayLabel.description: Any other marker outside the governed namespaces. Never a lookup key.

displayLabel.title: Work item display label
displayLabel.description: Governed namespaces must match their taxonomy shape; all other markers pass as ungoverned display labels.
